description: ClickHouse cluster admin dashboard — on-call incident response. Default time range: 6h.
title: ClickHouse Admin

panels.title: Storage Used (Hot) — per Pod
panels.description: Hot storage (PowerFlex). Adjust 'default' in metric name to match your disk name.

panels.title: Failed Queries/sec — per Pod
panels.description: Rate of failed queries per pod. A spike on one pod points to a bad replica.

panels.title: Top Errors — system.errors
panels.description: Top ClickHouse errors by occurrence count across all nodes. Reset on server restart.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, value AS count, toDateTime(last_error_time) AS last_error_time FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.errors) WHERE value > 0 ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Insert Throughput — per Table
panels.description: Rows/sec per table from system.query_log.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $__interval second) AS time, tables[1] AS table, sum(written_rows) / $__interval AS rows_per_sec FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time >= toDateTime(intDiv($__from, 1000)) AND event_time <= toDateTime(intDiv($__to, 1000)) AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind = 'Insert' AND length(tables) > 0 AND database != 'system' GROUP BY time, table ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Active Parts — per Table (Current Snapshot)
panels.description: Current part count per table. High part counts indicate merge lag.

targets.rawSql: SELECT database, table, count() AS active_parts, sum(rows) AS total_rows, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS size_on_disk, max(modification_time) AS last_modified FROM system.parts WHERE active = 1 AND database != 'system' GROUP BY database, table ORDER BY active_parts DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Async Insert — Pending Queue Depth
panels.description: Pending async inserts buffered server-side. A growing queue risks data loss if the server restarts.

panels.title: Query Latency (avg) — per Pod
panels.description: Average query duration in ms. ClickHouse does not expose latency histograms via Prometheus; p99 requires system.query_log.

panels.title: Merge Pool Saturation
panels.description: Active merges vs pool size (left axis). Saturation % on right axis. When saturation reaches 100% and part count is rising, merges cannot keep pace with inserts.

panels.title: Async Insert Buffered Flushes/sec
panels.description: Rate of async insert buffer flushes to disk. High flush rate means many small insert batches.

panels.title: Replication Queue Depth — per Replica
panels.description: Queue depth per replica (pod). Each row is one replica. Uses clusterAllReplicas to query all nodes simultaneously.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname() AS replica, database, table, count() AS queue_depth FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.replication_queue) GROUP BY replica, database, table ORDER BY queue_depth DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Replication Lag — per Replica
panels.description: Age of the oldest pending replication task per replica. Growing lag means a replica is falling behind.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname() AS replica, max(dateDiff('second', create_time, now())) AS lag_seconds FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.replication_queue) GROUP BY replica ORDER BY lag_seconds DESC

panels.title: ClickHouse Keeper — Liveness per Pod
panels.description: Shows ALIVE (green) if the pod has at least one active Keeper session, DEAD (red) if zero. Loss of Keeper connectivity stops all replication and DDL.

panels.title: S3 Storage Used
panels.description: Total bytes in S3 tiered storage. Adjust 's3' in metric name to match your S3 disk name.

panels.title: S3 GET Operations/sec
panels.description: S3 GET request rate. High rate may indicate excessive cold data access during merges.

panels.title: S3 Merge Reads (bytes/sec)
panels.description: Bytes read from S3 by background merges on tiered data.

panels.title: Failed Replicated Part Fetches/sec
panels.description: Failed attempts to fetch a replicated part. Sustained failures indicate a broken replica or network issue.

panels.title: Total Active Parts — per Pod
panels.description: Total active MergeTree parts. A rising trend means merges are not keeping pace with inserts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT database, table, count() AS active_parts, sum(rows) AS total_rows, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS size_on_disk FROM system.parts WHERE active = 1 AND database != 'system' GROUP BY database, table ORDER BY active_parts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Parts per Partition — Top 20
panels.description: Partitions with the most active parts. High per-partition counts indicate merge lag within that partition.

targets.rawSql: SELECT database, table, partition, count() AS parts, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS size FROM system.parts WHERE active = 1 AND database != 'system' GROUP BY database, table, partition ORDER BY parts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Largest Parts by Size — Top 20
panels.description: Individual parts sorted by disk size. Useful for identifying unexpectedly large parts that may slow merges.

targets.rawSql: SELECT database, table, name, partition, rows, formatReadableSize(bytes_on_disk) AS size_on_disk, formatReadableSize(data_uncompressed_bytes) AS size_uncompressed FROM system.parts WHERE active = 1 AND database != 'system' ORDER BY bytes_on_disk DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Detached Parts — per Node
panels.description: Detached parts are excluded from queries and merges. They accumulate due to replica repair, failed fetches, or manual detach. Non-zero counts require investigation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname() AS node, database, table, reason, count() AS detached_parts FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.detached_parts) GROUP BY node, database, table, reason ORDER BY detached_parts DESC LIMIT 30
